# 7411 - Triple 3-input positive-AND gates

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7411.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7411.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 1Y = 1A AND 1B AND 1C | 1Y is high only when 1A, 1B and 1C are all high. |
| 6 | 2Y = 2A AND 2B AND 2C | 2Y is high only when 2A, 2B and 2C are all high. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3A AND 3B AND 3C | 3Y is high only when 3A, 3B and 3C are all high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 8 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74LS11 figures (page 3). SN74S11: IOL 20 mA, IOH -1 mA (page 4). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any input | Y | PLH | 8 | 15 |
| any input | Y | PHL | 10 | 20 |

## Notes

Timing is the SN74LS11 table (page 3). SN74S11 (page 4, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): tPLH 4.5/7 ns, tPHL 5/7.5 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS11 and 74S11 too.
